# A third-party Go module (a golang.org/x module path) counts as a Go
# package that loGo/s code imports [A-XMOD][R-U2].
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin
cd x
logos build -o $WORK/bin/xgeom$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/xgeom$GOEXE
stdout '^x-geom$'
cd ..

-- x/go.mod --
module example.com/x

go 1.27

require golang.org/x/geom v0.0.0

replace golang.org/x/geom => ./third

-- x/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"golang.org/x/geom"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(geom.Label()) }

-- x/third/go.mod --
module golang.org/x/geom

go 1.27

-- x/third/label.go --
package geom

func Label() string { return "x-geom" }
